summary: Applied the target-external dirty precedence rule across constraints, requirements, acceptance criteria, and task notes.

items.title: R3 and R4 do not define the external-dirty retry-reset intersection
items.rationale: The spec now states that any target-external dirty path blocks all finalize-merge pre-hook metadata mutation/commit, including downstream skipped reset. Reset behavior is preserved only when no target-external dirty path exists.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[4], requirements R3/R4, acceptance_criteria, and tasks now define the precedence.
